Shows when the Android standard mock provider is active

1. Choose a point on the map or enter a WGS-84 coordinate, then save.

2. Standard mode: enable Developer options, choose FakeMap under “Select mock location app”, return here and tap Start simulation. This mode does not require root or Xposed and keeps Android’s official mock marker.

3. Xposed mode: use legacy for original Xposed on Android 6 or a New XSharedPreferences-compatible legacy framework; use modern for libxposed API 101/102. Enable the module, scope FakeMap and each target, enter matching package names, save, then force-stop and reopen targets. Original Xposed on Android 7/8 is not supported.

4. China map: Amap is a developer/BYO Key option for mainland points. Production distribution requires Amap serviceHost or a compliant native SDK. International map: Leaflet uses the configured HTTPS raster service; public OSM has no SLA.

5. Coordinates are stored as WGS-84. Amap points inside mainland China are converted from GCJ-02 before saving.

6. Stop simulation before uninstalling. FakeMap does not fabricate GNSS raw measurements, hide mock-location markers, alter Wi-Fi/cellular state, or bypass integrity and anti-abuse systems. Use only on devices and apps you are authorized to test.
